erin (partnerships): IronFlow asked for a rapid perf/W smoke tomorrow 11:00am PT to sanity-check kernel patches against their dev board. They only want aggregated outputs. Can bench/runtime/kernel align on a minimal artifact set? Link: https://go/redwood/ironflow-smoke :mag:

mike (eng-performance): I'll run three quick profiles: stock, memcpy-tuned, cache-warm. Export: metrics_<run_id>.csv, power_<run_id>.csv, hotspots_<run_id>.tsv (anonymized). What's the agreed power cap?

sana (kernel-team): Patch is a small memcpy path opt. We'll not share kallsyms or raw perf.data. We can provide anonymized hotspots with ids and ms self-time. We'll include `kernel_build_id` only.

jules (bench-ops): I'll reserve rack and attach the meter. Bench-bot will tag uploads with run_id=ironflow-2026-07-08-1 and push to s3://redwood-partner-exchange/ironflow/. I'll redact hostnames from metadata. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/ironflow-smoke.

ironflow-hw: We can provide wall-power CSV at 200ms and SoC telemetry (freq,temp). Our parser expects headers: ts_ms,power_w,soc_freq_mhz,board_temp_c,run_id. Read-only S3 please.

mike (eng-performance): Proposed command (quick smoke):

```
./bench_runner --model=redwood-mini --seq=1024 --batch=8 \
  --profiles=stock,memcpy-tuned,cache-warm --runs=2 \
  --export-agg=metrics_<run_id>.csv --export-power=power_<run_id>.csv \
  --export-hotspots=hotspots_<run_id>.tsv --agg-hotspots=6 \
  --limit-watts=140
```

jules (bench-ops): bench-bot will run a 3m validation then full 25m sweep. I'll ensure power meter is logged and that `run_id` is embedded in all artifacts. Artifacts will be uploaded with partner read-only access.

sana (kernel-team): Telemetry contract (headers for metrics CSV): `run_id,timestamp_s,throughput_tok_s,avg_power_w,efficiency_tok_per_w,kv_cache_hit_rate,hotspot_count`. I'll push a tiny PR to bench-metadata with that schema (no symbols).

ironflow-hw: Confirmed. We'll join the Zoom and provide power CSVs. We'll not accept any host-identifying artifacts.

erin (partnerships): Action items: jules - run orchestration + upload; sana - telemetry contract PR; mike - update runbook with exact commands + sample CSVs; ironflow-hw - confirm read-only S3 ACL. Reconvene here after ~12:15 PT for initial readout. :rocket:

bench-bot: Prechecks passed. Rack-7 reserved. Run queued. Will post a condensed summary (throughput, avg power, efficiency, hotspots) once done. :robot_face:
